abstract: PURPOSE: To establish a seminoma orthotopic model with lymph node metastasis to investigate the factors related to the lymphophilic behavior of seminoma cells. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Testicular seminoma xenografts were established by the inoculation of small fragments from subcutaneous (s.c.) xenografts that had previously been established in severe combined immunodeficient (SCID) mice with a supraclavicular lymph node metastasis from a human seminoma. Hematologic dissemination of tumor cells was analyzed by polymerase chain reaction (PCR) amplification of the human beta-globin gene. Xenograft messenger RNA levels of metastasis-related genes were examined by reverse transcription (RT)-PCR. RESULTS: Testicular seminoma xenografts grew in 32/32 (100%) of the inoculated mice, of which 15 mice (47%) developed macroscopic metastasis to the renal hilar lymph node. Circulating tumor cells and tumor cell shedding in the lung and liver were detectable by PCR assay in 25/32 (78%), 32/32 (100%), and 27/32 (84%) mice, respectively, although metastatic foci were not histologically evident in these organs. Increased expression of matrix metalloproteinase-2 (MMP-2), membrane-type 3 matrix metalloproteinase (MT3-MMP) and vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), and reduction in expression of plasminogen activator inhibitor-2 (PAI-2) were demonstrated by RT-PCR assay in the testicular xenografts as compared with the s.c. xenografts. CONCLUSIONS: This model mimics the lymphophilic behavior of seminoma and may help in elucidating the molecular mechanism of tumor spread via the lymphatics.
abstract_ja:
目的：セミノーマ細胞のリンパ節親和性に関連する因子を検討するため、リンパ節転移を伴う精巣セミノーマの同所性モデルを作成すること。
材料と方法：鎖骨上リンパ節転移を有するヒトセミノーマ由来で、SCIDマウス内に皮下で確立された異種移植片の小片を、精巣内へ接種して精巣異種移植片を作成した。血中の循環腫瘍細胞は、ヒトβグロビン遺伝子のPCR増幅で解析した。異種移植片における転移関連遺伝子のmRNA量は、RT-PCRで解析した。
結果：精巣セミノーマ異種移植片は接種したマウス32/32匹(100%)で増殖し、そのうち15匹(47%)で腎門部リンパ節に肉眼的な転移が生じた。循環腫瘍細胞、ならびに肺および肝での腫瘍細胞の散布は、PCRアッセイでそれぞれ25/32(78%)、32/32(100%)、27/32(84%)のマウスで検出されたが、これらの臓器では組織学的に転移巣は明らかでなかった。RT-PCRアッセイでは、皮下異種移植片と比べて精巣異種移植片でMMP-2、MT3-MMP、VEGFの発現増加と、PAI-2の発現低下が認められた。
結論：本モデルはセミノーマのリンパ行性転移の特性を再現しており、リンパ管を介した腫瘍の広がりの分子機構の解明に役立つ可能性がある。
